ℹ️ What's in the AI Digital Passport — and what's not

The AI Digital Passport is a 24-lesson pathway aligned to the four domains of the OECD/EU AI Literacy Framework — Engage, Create, Manage and Shape AI. Most lessons are curated from the full course; the closing "Managing & Shaping AI" section is shared with the Removes course. A focused route for learners who want recognised AI literacy without a formal syllabus.

Included:

  • How LLMs actually work · prompting · hallucinations · bias
  • Spotting deepfakes, misinformation and AI-generated content
  • Practical use: writing, research, and when not to use AI
  • A printable certificate when you finish all 24 lessons

Not included (available in the full course):

  • GCSE Computer Science exam prep and mark-scheme practice
  • Unit assessments, teacher-facing resources, gradebook
  • Deeper technical lessons (transformers internals, RL, training pipelines)

Works offline: after your first visit, lessons, slides and images are cached to your device. You can open this page with no connection and keep learning. Your progress is saved locally (clearing browser data resets it).
